verdict.rationale: GitHub Mobile is a mobile client for GitHub collaboration: pull requests, issues, notifications and Copilot tasks. Routing all internet traffic through an exit node is a VPN/mesh-networking capability, so this story is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any traffic-routing feature.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can route all my internet traffic through a specific device on my network using an exit node
